box-jump.setup: Stand facing a sturdy box about an arm's length away, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Swing your arms back and bend your hips and knees into a quarter squat.
Swing your arms forward and jump up explosively onto the box.
Land softly with both feet flat, knees bent, near the box centre.
Stand tall, then step down one foot at a time.
mistakes: Jumping down off the box, which stresses the Achilles
Choosing a box too high to land safely
box-jump.breathing: Breathe in as you load the jump and out as you take off.

bulgarian-split-squat.setup: Stand facing away from a bench, rear foot resting on it, a dumbbell in each hand.
steps: Step your front foot forward so your hips stay square and balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso tall and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Press through the front heel to stand back up.
mistakes: Standing too close to the bench, which pinches the front knee
Pushing off the back foot instead of the front leg
bulgarian-split-squat.breathing: Breathe in on the way down and out as you drive up.

walking-lunge.setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, with space to walk forward.
steps: Step forward with one leg in a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring your back leg forward.
Step straight into the next lunge with the other leg.
mistakes: Taking steps too short, which overloads the knee
Leaning forward and letting the trunk collapse
walking-lunge.breathing: Breathe in as you lower and out as you step through.

reverse-lunge.setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Step one leg straight back, landing on the ball of that foot.
Lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your front shin near vertical and your chest up.
Push through the front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.
cues: Back knee hovers above the floor
mistakes: Stepping back on a tightrope line, losing balance
Letting the front knee collapse inward
reverse-lunge.breathing: Breathe in on the way down and out as you drive up.

barbell-lunge.setup: Rack a barbell across your upper back as for a squat, then step back with feet hip-width apart.
steps: Brace your core and step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, front shin near vertical.
Push hard through the front foot to return to the start.
Repeat on the other leg, or finish all reps on one side first.
cues: Keep the bar still on your back
mistakes: Leaning forward and letting the bar roll
Using a load too heavy to control your balance
barbell-lunge.breathing: Breathe in on the way down and out as you drive up.

bodyweight-lunge.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
steps: Step forward with one leg in a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your toes.
Push through the front foot back to the start, then switch legs.
mistakes: Short steps that load the front knee too much
Letting the front knee cave inward
bodyweight-lunge.breathing: Breathe in on the way down and out as you drive up.

step-up.setup: Stand facing a sturdy bench or box with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
steps: Place one whole foot firmly on the box.
Press through that heel to stand up fully on the box.
Lower slowly back down with control, trailing foot first.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch.
mistakes: Pushing off the back foot to cheat the rep
Using a box so high your hips rise above the knee
step-up.breathing: Breathe in on the way down and out as you drive up.

lateral-lunge.setup: Stand tall with feet together, holding one dumbbell at your chest with both hands.
steps: Take a big step out to the side with one foot, toes forward.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your bent-knee heel flat.
Push off the bent leg to return to the middle, then switch sides.
mistakes: Rounding the back as you lower
Letting the working heel lift off the floor
lateral-lunge.breathing: Breathe in on the way down and out as you drive up.

curtsy-lunge.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
steps: Step one leg back and across behind the other, like a curtsy.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your hips and chest facing forward.
Push through the front heel to return, then repeat or switch.
mistakes: Twisting the torso instead of stepping across
Stepping so far across that you lose balance
curtsy-lunge.breathing: Breathe in on the way down and out as you drive up.

leg-extension.setup: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and the roller resting on your lower shins.
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine's pivot.
Grip the handles and extend your knees until legs are almost straight.
Squeeze your thighs for a second at the top.
Lower slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
cues: Keep hips pressed into the seat
mistakes: Swinging the weight up with momentum
Locking the knees hard at the top
leg-extension.breathing: Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

single-leg-leg-extension.setup: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and one shin under the roller.
steps: Adjust the seat so your knee lines up with the machine's pivot.
Extend one knee until the leg is almost straight.
Pause and squeeze your thigh for a second.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
cues: One leg at a time, no twisting
mistakes: Leaning back or lifting the hips to help
Using a weight that makes the rep jerky
single-leg-leg-extension.breathing: Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

romanian-deadlift.setup: Stand holding a barbell at hip height with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Soften your knees, brace your core and pull your shoulders back.
Push your hips back, sliding the bar down your thighs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
cues: Keep the bar close to your legs
mistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom
Bending the knees too much so it becomes a squat
romanian-deadlift.breathing: Breathe in as you lower and out as you stand.

dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Soften your knees, brace your core and pull your shoulders back.
Push your hips back, sliding the dumbbells down your legs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
cues: Dumbbells stay close to the legs
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower
Letting the dumbbells drift away from your legs
dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.breathing: Breathe in as you lower and out as you stand.

single-leg-romanian-deadlift.setup: Stand on one foot holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand, standing knee slightly bent.
steps: Brace your core and hinge forward at the hip.
Extend your free leg straight behind you as the dumbbell lowers.
Keep your hips level and back flat until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing, then switch legs.
cues: Hips stay square to the floor
Reach long through the back heel
mistakes: Opening the hips and twisting the torso
Rounding the back to reach the floor
single-leg-romanian-deadlift.breathing: Breathe in as you lower and out as you stand.

stiff-leg-deadlift.setup: Stand holding a barbell at hip height with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart, knees nearly straight.
steps: Brace your core and keep your knees only slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips, sliding the bar down your legs.
Lower to about mid-shin or until your hamstrings are tight.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
mistakes: Rounding the back, which loads the spine
Going lower than your flexibility allows
stiff-leg-deadlift.breathing: Breathe in as you lower and out as you stand.

kettlebell-swing.setup: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders, a kettlebell on the floor a step in front of you.
steps: Hinge at the hips and grip the bell with both hands, back flat.
Hike the bell back between your legs, forearms near your thighs.
Snap your hips forward to swing the bell up to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping the rhythm smooth.
cues: Stand tall and squeeze glutes at top
mistakes: Squatting the swing instead of hinging
Lifting the bell with your arms or leaning back
kettlebell-swing.breathing: Breathe out sharply on the hip snap and in as the bell drops.

lying-leg-curl.setup: Lie face down on the machine with the pad resting just above your heels and hips flat.
steps: Grip the handles and keep your hips pressed into the bench.
Curl your heels toward your glutes as far as comfortable.
Squeeze your hamstrings for a second at the top.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.
cues: Hips stay glued to the bench
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the pad to swing the weight
Dropping the weight quickly on the way down
lying-leg-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you curl and in as you lower.

seated-leg-curl.setup: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and the roller just above your heels.
steps: Set the thigh pad snug so your legs cannot lift.
Curl your heels down and back as far as comfortable.
Squeeze your hamstrings for a second at the bottom.
Let the legs rise back slowly until nearly straight.
mistakes: Leaning forward to cheat the curl
Letting the weight stack slam back up
seated-leg-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you curl and in as you return.

nordic-hamstring-curl.setup: Kneel on a pad with your ankles anchored under a bar or held by a partner, body straight from knees to head.
steps: Cross your arms or hold them ready to catch yourself.
Keep your hips extended and lean forward as slowly as you can.
Lower until you can no longer hold, then catch yourself with your hands.
Push off the floor lightly and pull back up with your hamstrings.
cues: Straight line from knee to head
mistakes: Bending at the hips as you fall forward
Dropping fast with no control at all
nordic-hamstring-curl.breathing: Breathe in as you lean forward and out as you recover.

glute-ham-raise.setup: Set up on the GHR machine with feet braced on the plate and thighs on the pad, hips just past the edge.
steps: Cross your arms and start with your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor by hinging at the hips.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up.
Finish tall without leaning back past a straight line.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top
Using momentum to bounce out of the bottom
glute-ham-raise.breathing: Breathe in as you lower and out as you rise.

stability-ball-leg-curl.setup: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and arms flat by your sides.
steps: Press your hips up so your body forms a straight line.
Pull your heels toward your glutes, rolling the ball in.
Hold the hips high and squeeze your hamstrings.
Roll the ball slowly back out without dropping your hips.
cues: Keep hips high all the time
mistakes: Letting the hips sag as the ball moves
Rolling the ball too fast to control it
stability-ball-leg-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you curl in and in as you extend.

barbell-hip-thrust.setup: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell across your hips.
steps: Plant your feet hip-width apart with your knees bent.
Brace your core and drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Stop when your torso is level, shins vertical, and squeeze glutes.
Lower under control until your glutes are just above the floor.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top
Pushing through the toes with feet too close
barbell-hip-thrust.breathing: Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

machine-hip-thrust.setup: Sit in the machine with your upper back on the pad and the belt or pad across your hips.
steps: Set your feet flat, hip-width apart, knees bent.
Brace your core and drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Pause at the top with your glutes squeezed hard.
Lower under control to the start.
mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top
Dropping the weight quickly on the way down
machine-hip-thrust.breathing: Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

single-leg-hip-thrust.setup: Sit with your upper back against a bench, one foot planted and the other leg raised, knee bent.
steps: Brace your core and press through the planted heel.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
cues: Squeeze the glute at the top
mistakes: Letting the hips rotate or drop to one side
Arching the lower back at the top
single-leg-hip-thrust.breathing: Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

glute-bridge.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat hip-width apart, and arms by your sides.
steps: Brace your core and press through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top for a second.
Lower slowly until your hips almost touch the floor.
mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top
Pushing through the toes and straining the knees
glute-bridge.breathing: Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

cable-pull-through.setup: Stand facing away from a low cable with a rope between your legs, a few steps out from the stack.
steps: Hold the rope with both hands and walk forward until there is tension.
Hinge your hips back, letting the rope pass between your legs.
Keep your back flat and feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
mistakes: Squatting instead of hinging
Pulling with the arms or leaning back at the top
cable-pull-through.breathing: Breathe in as you hinge back and out as you stand.

cable-glute-kickback.setup: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and face the machine, holding the frame for support.
steps: Strap the cuff on one ankle and step back to create tension.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Kick your leg straight back, squeezing your glute at the end.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack rest, then switch.
cues: Squeeze the glute at the top
mistakes: Arching the lower back to kick higher
Swinging the leg with momentum
cable-glute-kickback.breathing: Breathe out as you kick back and in as you return.

hip-abduction-machine.setup: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and the pads against the outside of your knees.
steps: Adjust the pads and select a light to moderate weight.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Push your knees apart as far as you comfortably can.
Pause briefly, then bring them back together slowly.
cues: Press out with the outer hips
mistakes: Rocking the torso to push the weight
Letting the pads slam shut between reps
hip-abduction-machine.breathing: Breathe out as you push out and in as you return.

banded-lateral-walk.setup: Place a resistance band just above your knees or around your ankles and stand in a quarter squat.
steps: Keep your feet hip-width apart with tension in the band.
Step sideways with your lead foot, keeping toes forward.
Follow with the trailing foot without letting the feet touch.
Take 10 to 15 steps one way, then walk back the other way.
cues: Stay low in a quarter squat
mistakes: Letting the knees cave inward
Standing up tall and losing band tension
banded-lateral-walk.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

clamshell.setup: Lie on your side with knees bent about 45 degrees, a band above your knees, feet together.
steps: Stack your hips and rest your head on your lower arm.
Keep your feet together and lift your top knee up.
Stop before your pelvis starts to roll backward.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
cues: Squeeze the side of the glute
mistakes: Rolling the pelvis back to lift higher
Using momentum instead of the glute
clamshell.breathing: Breathe out as you lift your knee and in as you lower.

frog-pump.setup: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out to the sides.
steps: Pull your heels in close to your glutes.
Brace your core and press through your feet.
Lift your hips until you feel a strong glute squeeze.
Lower slowly and repeat, keeping a steady pace.
cues: Squeeze glutes hard at the top
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of using glutes
Pushing off your hands or neck
frog-pump.breathing: Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

hip-adduction-machine.setup: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and the pads on the inside of your knees.
steps: Adjust the starting width to a comfortable stretch and pick a light weight.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Squeeze your knees together smoothly.
Pause, then let the legs open slowly under control.
mistakes: Opening too wide and straining the groin
Letting the weight slam back at the end
hip-adduction-machine.breathing: Breathe out as you squeeze in and in as you open.

standing-calf-raise.setup: Stand under the shoulder pads of the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform edge.
steps: Straighten your knees and lift the weight off the stack.
Lower your heels until you feel a deep calf stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom with momentum
Cutting the range of motion short
standing-calf-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you rise and in as you lower.

seated-calf-raise.setup: Sit in the machine with the pads on your lower thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform.
steps: Release the safety and let your heels drop for a calf stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze for a second at the top.
Lower slowly back to the deep stretch.
mistakes: Bouncing the weight at the bottom
Using a half range of motion
seated-calf-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you rise and in as you lower.

leg-press-calf-raise.setup: Sit in a leg press with the balls of your feet on the lower edge of the platform, legs almost straight.
steps: Release the safety and keep your knees softly extended.
Let your toes pull back to feel a calf stretch.
Press through the balls of your feet to rise high.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Locking or bending the knees during reps
Using so much weight the range shrinks
leg-press-calf-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you press and in as you return.

single-leg-calf-raise.setup: Stand on one foot with the ball of that foot on a step edge, holding a wall or rail for balance.
steps: Let your heel drop below the step for a calf stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause and squeeze the calf at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
mistakes: Bouncing fast without a full range
Leaning on the rail so the calf does less
single-leg-calf-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you rise and in as you lower.

donkey-calf-raise.setup: Stand with the balls of your feet on a platform, hips hinged forward and the machine pad on your lower back.
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back and hold the support.
Let your heels drop for a deep calf stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Bouncing at the bottom of the rep
Rounding the back under the load
donkey-calf-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you rise and in as you lower.

tibialis-raise.setup: Stand with your back against a wall, feet about 30 cm out in front, heels on the floor.
steps: Keep your legs straight and your back on the wall.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the front of your shins.
Lower slowly until your toes touch the floor.
mistakes: Bending the knees to cheat the lift
Moving fast with a short range
tibialis-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

hanging-hip-flexor-raise.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight and legs together, shoulders pulled down.
steps: Brace your core and keep your torso still.
Bend your knees and lift them up toward your chest.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Stop the swing before the next rep.
cues: Lift with the hips, not momentum
mistakes: Swinging the body to get the legs up
Letting the shoulders shrug up to the ears
hanging-hip-flexor-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

cable-hip-flexion.setup: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand facing away, holding a support for balance.
steps: Strap the cuff on one ankle and step forward to create tension.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Drive your knee up and forward to hip height.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
mistakes: Leaning back to swing the leg up
Letting the cable yank the leg back
cable-hip-flexion.breathing: Breathe out as you lift your knee and in as you lower.

sled-push.setup: Stand behind a loaded sled, hands on the posts at about chest height, body leaning forward.
steps: Set your feet back with your arms straight and torso at an angle.
Drive through your legs to push the sled forward.
Take powerful, steady steps, keeping your back flat.
Stop after the set distance and rest.
mistakes: Rounding the back and dropping the hips
Standing too upright so the sled stalls
sled-push.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

sled-pull-backwards.setup: Attach straps or a belt to a loaded sled and face it, standing tall with the line taut.
steps: Hold the straps or belt and lean back slightly.
Walk backwards, driving through your whole foot each step.
Keep your knees bent slightly and chest tall.
Stop at the set distance, then turn and rest.
mistakes: Leaning back too far and losing balance
Taking steps so long that the knee strains
sled-pull-backwards.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

power-clean.setup: Stand over a barbell with feet hip-width apart, hands just outside your knees, back flat.
steps: Set your back tight and pull the bar off the floor to your knees.
Explode up through your hips and legs, shrugging your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders.
Stand tall, then lower the bar back to the floor with control.
cues: Fast elbows to catch the bar
mistakes: Pulling early with the arms instead of the legs
Rounding the back during the pull
power-clean.breathing: Brace and hold your breath at the start, then breathe out as you stand.

hang-clean.setup: Stand holding a barbell at mid-thigh with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart, back flat.
steps: Hinge slightly with the bar just above your knees.
Explode up through your hips and legs, shrugging your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders.
Stand tall, then lower the bar to your thighs under control.
cues: Jump, don't pull with the arms
Keep the bar close to you
mistakes: Pulling early with the arms instead of the legs
Catching the bar with low or dropped elbows
hang-clean.breathing: Brace and hold your breath at the start, then breathe out as you stand.

power-snatch.setup: Stand over a barbell with a wide overhand grip, feet hip-width apart, back flat.
steps: Set your back tight and pull the bar up past your knees.
Explode up through your hips and legs, shrugging hard.
Pull yourself under and catch the bar overhead in a quarter squat.
Stand fully with the bar overhead, then lower with control.
cues: Keep the bar close to you
Fast feet and locked arms overhead
Use a light weight to learn
mistakes: Pulling the bar away from your body
Catching with soft, bent elbows overhead
power-snatch.breathing: Brace and hold your breath at the start, then breathe out as you stand.

clean-and-jerk.setup: Stand over a barbell with feet hip-width apart, hands just outside your knees, back flat.
steps: Pull the bar off the floor and explode into a clean to your shoulders.
Stand tall, then dip slightly and drive the bar upward with your legs.
Split or push your feet and lock your arms overhead.
Bring your feet together, then lower the bar to your shoulders and floor.
cues: Learn each part with a light bar
Lock your arms and stand tall
mistakes: Pressing with the arms instead of driving with the legs
Rounding the back during the pull
clean-and-jerk.breathing: Brace at the start of each lift, then breathe out as you stand.

thruster.setup: Hold a barbell in the front rack position on your shoulders, feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Brace your core and squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up powerfully through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the bar overhead to lock out.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders and go into the next squat.
cues: Stand and press in one motion
Brace your core all the way
mistakes: Pressing before the legs finish driving
Letting the elbows drop and the bar roll forward
thruster.breathing: Breathe in at the bottom and out as you press overhead.

dumbbell-thruster.setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing in, feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Brace your core and squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up powerfully through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower to your shoulders and go straight into the next squat.
cues: Stand and press in one motion
Brace your core all the way
mistakes: Pressing before the legs finish driving
Arching the lower back on the press
dumbbell-thruster.breathing: Breathe in at the bottom and out as you press overhead.

kettlebell-clean-and-press.setup: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet, feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Hinge down and hike the bell back, then snap your hips forward.
Guide the bell up to rest on your forearm at your shoulder.
Brace and press it straight overhead until your arm locks out.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then back to the floor.
cues: Keep the bell close to your body
mistakes: Banging the bell hard on your wrist or forearm
Leaning back and arching to press the bell
kettlebell-clean-and-press.breathing: Breathe out as you drive up and press, in as you lower.

kettlebell-snatch.setup: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor a step in front of you, feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Hinge and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Punch your hand through so the bell lands overhead softly.
Lock out, then guide the bell back down to the next swing.
mistakes: Letting the bell flip and slam onto your forearm
Pulling the bell out and away from your body
kettlebell-snatch.breathing: Breathe out as you drive up and in as the bell drops.

turkish-get-up.setup: Lie on your back with a kettlebell held straight above one shoulder, same-side knee bent.
steps: Press up onto your opposite elbow, then your hand, eyes on the bell.
Bridge your hips and sweep your straight leg back into a kneel.
Stand up from the lunge position, bell still above you.
Reverse each step slowly to lie back down.
mistakes: Letting the bell arm drift away from vertical
Rushing the transitions
turkish-get-up.breathing: Breathe steadily and brace at each new position.

man-maker.setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, with feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Place the dumbbells down and jump your feet back into a plank.
Do a push-up, then row one dumbbell, then the other.
Jump your feet in and stand while pulling the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead and lower them to start.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag in the plank
Using weights too heavy for the full sequence
man-maker.breathing: Breathe in on the floor work and out as you stand and press.

burpee.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides.
steps: Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank, chest to the floor.
Press up, jump your feet to your hands, and stand.
Jump up with your arms overhead, then go into the next rep.
mistakes: Letting the lower back sag in the plank
Landing the jump on stiff, straight legs
burpee.breathing: Breathe out as you jump up and in as you go down.

wall-ball.setup: Stand facing a wall about an arm's length away, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
steps: Squat down with your chest up until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up powerfully and throw the ball at a target on the wall.
Catch the ball as it comes down and absorb it into the squat.
Go straight into the next squat and throw.
mistakes: Throwing with the arms and not the legs
Squatting shallow with the heels lifting
wall-ball.breathing: Breathe in as you squat and out as you throw.

battle-ropes.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a quarter squat, holding one rope end in each hand.
steps: Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Move your arms up and down in fast alternating waves.
Keep the waves travelling smoothly along the rope.
Work for a set time, such as 20 to 30 seconds, then rest.
mistakes: Rounding the back as you tire
Using only the arms while the legs stay still
battle-ropes.breathing: Breathe steadily and rhythmically; do not hold your breath.

rowing-machine.setup: Sit on the rowing machine with feet strapped in, shins vertical, and hands gripping the handle.
steps: Start with arms straight and knees bent, leaning slightly forward.
Push through your legs first, then lean back slightly.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs with elbows close.
Reverse the order: arms out, lean forward, then bend the knees.
cues: Legs, body, arms. Then arms, body, legs
mistakes: Pulling with the arms before the legs have pushed
Rounding the back at the catch
rowing-machine.breathing: Breathe out on the drive and in as you glide forward.

assault-bike.setup: Sit on the bike with the seat set so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal.
steps: Grip the handles and set your feet on the pedals.
Push and pull the handles as you pedal at a steady pace.
Keep your torso tall and your core braced.
Ride for the set time or distance, then cool down slowly.
cues: Drive with arms and legs together
mistakes: Setting the seat too low or too high
Gripping the handles tightly with tense shoulders
assault-bike.breathing: Breathe steadily; match your breathing to your pace.

ski-erg.setup: Stand facing the machine with feet shoulder-width apart, holding both handles overhead.
steps: Reach up tall with your arms and brace your core.
Pull the handles down toward your hips, bending the knees slightly.
Hinge at the hips as the handles pass your thighs.
Rise back up, letting the handles return overhead.
cues: Pull with the lats and core
mistakes: Using only the arms with a rigid body
Bending the lower back instead of hinging at the hips
ski-erg.breathing: Breathe out as you pull down and in as you reach up.

bear-crawl.setup: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
steps: Lift your knees about 5 cm off the floor and brace your core.
Move your right hand and left foot forward together.
Then move your left hand and right foot forward.
Keep your back flat and hips low as you crawl.
cues: Knees hover just off the floor
mistakes: Piking the hips up into the air
Rushing so the steps lose control
bear-crawl.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

jumping-jacks.setup: Stand tall with your feet together and arms at your sides.
steps: Jump your feet out wide as you raise your arms overhead.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees slightly bent.
Jump your feet back together as your arms come down.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set time.
mistakes: Landing hard on stiff legs
Slouching forward as you get tired
jumping-jacks.breathing: Breathe steadily and rhythmically; do not hold your breath.

jump-rope.setup: Stand tall holding the rope handles at hip height, with the rope behind your heels.
steps: Keep your elbows close and your wrists doing the work.
Swing the rope overhead and jump just high enough to clear it.
Land softly on the balls of your feet each time.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set time.
cues: Turn the rope from the wrists
mistakes: Jumping too high and wasting energy
Landing flat on your heels with locked knees
jump-rope.breathing: Breathe steadily and rhythmically; do not hold your breath.

sandbag-carry.setup: Stand over a sandbag with feet shoulder-width apart, with space to walk.
steps: Hinge down and wrap your arms around the bag.
Lift it to your chest or over one shoulder, standing tall.
Brace your core and walk with short, steady steps.
Set the bag down with control at the end of the distance.
mistakes: Rounding the back as the bag tires you
Leaning to one side when carrying on a shoulder
sandbag-carry.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

tire-flip.setup: Stand close to a large tire, feet shoulder-width apart, and drop your hands under its edge.
steps: Squat down, chest up, and grip under the tire's edge.
Drive up through your legs, keeping your back flat.
As the tire rises, step in and push it over with your chest and arms.
Reset your stance and repeat.
mistakes: Rounding the back to yank the tire up
Standing up with the arms before the legs drive
tire-flip.breathing: Take a big breath and brace before the lift, then breathe out as you flip.
